chunks: We have sent revelations to you as We sent revelations to Noah and the prophets who came after him; and We sent revelations to Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob, and their offspring, and to Jesus and Job, and to Jonah and Aaron and Solomon, and to David We gave the Book of Psalms.
ai.seo_question: Which prophets received divine revelation according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah An-Nisa (4:163) establishes the continuity of divine revelation (wahy) by listing key prophets, including Noah, Abraham, Moses, Jesus, and David, thereby validating Muhammad’s prophethood as part of an unbroken chain. In Shia scholarship, this enumeration underscores the universality of Islam and the shared core message of monotheism across all messengers, reinforcing the concept of Tawhid. The mention of specific prophets like Jesus and David also highlights their unique roles in Islamic theology, with David receiving the Zabur (Psalms) as a divine book.
